Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Naira - 8 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Anita - 36 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Anita and Naira stand near him.]

Anita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya lies down on the sofa.]

Anita: "Let's see."

[Aditya sits down on a chair.]

Anita (softly): "Yes, of course."

[Aditya flops down on the sofa.]

Aditya: "Exactly right."

[Aditya sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Anita (gently): "What next?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Naira and Anita stand near him.]

Aditya: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya folds his hands and prays.]

Anita: "Well done!"

[Aditya lights a diya.]

Anita (happily): "Hmm, I see."

[Naira draws a rangoli at the door.]

Anita: "This is amazing!"

[Aditya paints a picture.]

Anita: "Yes, of course."

[Aditya draws a picture of the house.]

Anita (gently): "That was such a fun day!"
